title: Representative of Institutional Administrator
age_limit: Maximum Age Limit: 62 years as on 01.11.2026
summary: The Maharashtra State Co-operative Bank Ltd. is inviting applications for the position of Senior Officer as a Representative of Institutional Administrator on a contract basis for one year initially. Eligible candidates with a Graduate or Post Graduate degree and relevant rural cooperative banking experience must submit their offline applications by 07.12.2026.
eligibility_bullets: Maximum age limit of 62 years as on 01.11.2026.
Graduate or Post Graduate degree in any discipline.
Technical qualification having CAIIB / DBF / Diploma in Cooperative Business Management or equivalent; GDC&A would be preferable.
At least 15 years of work experience at the middle and senior level in Rural Cooperative Banking.

vacancy_breakdown.notes: On contract basis for one year initially

how_to_apply_steps: Download the application form and annexures from the official notice.
Fill in all required details, affix a recent passport-sized photograph, and sign across.
Enclose self-attested photocopies of relevant qualification and experience certificates.
Submit offline applications to the Managing Director at the specified Mumbai address on or before 07/12/2026.
